label: input f/j (also i,s,b) during original phase, early or late positions
explanation: Fires almost only on original-phase steps (96% of mass); tiny mass at the <DEL> step and almost none in the copy phase. Token selective: input f (14.7x lift) and j (6.1x) carry about 57% of mass, then i, s, b (together these five tokens hold about 82% of mass). Mostly the first occurrence of the token (in_first=1 holds 92% of mass). Position matters: f at t=0 is always active but with near-zero magnitude. The largest activations are f/j at t=7-8 (the last original tokens of long sequences, often followed by a moderate activation at <DEL>), plus t=1-3. Middle positions (t=4-6) seldom fire. Precision is low (about 0.24): most f/j inputs do not activate it, and which ones do depends on context that position and simple previous-token conditions do not capture (prev2 of x/1 helps a little).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=0 & in_tok=f (+8.14), t=1 & prev_tok=c (+7.14), t=1 & prev_tok=i (+7.09), t=1 & prev_tok=n (+7.06), t=1 & in_tok=j (+4.65), orig0=1 (+3.94). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.50), orig1=b (-3.36), orig0=g (-3.36), orig1=g (-2.72).
